# Branch-coverage floor for the CI `coverage` job.
#
# The suite covers every statement and branch in the scope declared by
# [tool.coverage.run] (src/axiomize + skills/axiomize/tools), so the floor is
# 100.00 with no headroom: a new function, an untested error path, or a
# platform branch exercised on only one OS fails CI.
#
# The previous floor was 65.00, recorded while the repository carried a large
# untested backlog against the widened (shipped-code) scope. The ratchet script
# (.github/scripts/coverage_ratchet.py) only lets the number move upward, which
# is how it reached 100.00; it still refuses any edit that lowers it.
100.00
